### 🚀 v1.1.0 Release Notes — 🇰🇷 Naver Map & Naver Place Korea Scraper API Suite: Business Leads, KRW Menus & Visitor Receipt Reviews (`$0.50 / 1K`)

Complete South Korea (대한민국) Naver Map (`map.naver.com`) & Naver Place (`m.place.naver.com`) 3-Engine Data Extraction Suite on Apify (`$0.50–$1.00 / 1,000 items`). Extract verified Korean POI business leads, phones, road/jibun addresses, WGS84 coordinates, KRW menu prices, SmartPlace/Naver Booking/NPay flags, and receipt-verified Visitor Reviews (영수증 방문자 리뷰) with zero login or Korean phone number required.

- 📓 **1-Click Interactive Google Colab Notebook:** [**Open `notebooks/quickstart.ipynb` in Colab**](https://colab.research.google.com/github/unitbytes/Naver-Map-Place-Scraper-API/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb)

- 🔧 **9-Node n8n Automation Workflows:** Ready-to-import `.json` templates under `n8n/` and at **[unitbytes.com/n8n](https://unitbytes.com/n8n/)**.
